primaryOutcomeMeasures.description: Phe tolerance was defined as the amount of dietary Phe prescribed (milligram per kilogram per day \[mg/kg/day\]) while maintaining blood Phe levels within the selected therapeutic target range (defined as greater than or equal to \[\>=\] 120 to less than \[\<\] 360 micromoles per liter \[mcmol/L\]).

groups.description: Kuvan® (sapropterin dihydrochloride) tablets were administered orally at a dose of 10 milligram/kilogram/day (mg/kg/day). If after 4 weeks, there was less than 20 percent (%) increase in subject's Phe tolerance versus baseline, the dose was escalated to 20 mg/kg/day. Phenylalanine (Phe)-restricted diet was adjusted every 2 weeks, based on the mean Phe levels of the previous 2 weeks using pre-defined Phe adjustment criteria.
groups.title: Kuvan® + Phe-restricted Diet

groups.description: Phenylalanine (Phe)-restricted diet was adjusted every 2 weeks, based on the mean Phe levels of the previous 2 weeks using pre-defined Phe adjustment criteria.
groups.title: Phe-restricted Diet

primaryOutcomeMeasures.populationDescription: Intention-to-treat (ITT) population consisted of all the randomized subjects at the start of the study and were analyzed according to the group allocated.
primaryOutcomeMeasures.title: Dietary Phenylalanine (Phe) Tolerance at Week 26
